svg.text: Layout B: explicit review mode, inline composer
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915. Synthetic sample: acme-co/orders-api #365, a migration diff, riley-k's question, one bot finding.
Start review turns the diff bar into a review bar; line taps then add drafts inline. Outside review a line tap posts one comment. Since my review is a chip in the diff.
Start review in the bar. A line tap outside review posts a single comment.
Not reviewing: composer opens inline under the line, Comment only.
